title: Validating the winning model by simulation
summary: Free simulation against history-conditioned prediction; checking a fitted model against model-independent measures of the data; a validation that fails because the fitted model performs too well; analysing latent variables from the winning model only; reporting model selection, fits and recovery.

objectives.description: Objectives for this unit will be finalised when it is prepared; the outline below names its scope and sources.

preparation.description: Read Rule 8 of Wilson and Collins (2019): validate by simulating with the fitted parameters.
Read Box 7: a failed validation in which the fitted model performs too well.
Read Rule 9: analysing latent variables and individual differences from the winning model only.
Read Rule 10: what to report about model selection, fits and recovery.
